description: Get the status and details of one video the caller owns, by id. While rendering, status is PENDING/GENERATING_*/RENDERING and estimatedCompletionTime (seconds) is returned. When status is COMPLETED, a playable videoUrl and thumbnailUrl are returned; when FAILED, error says why, and a failure for lack of credits adds blockedReason "INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS" with creditsNeeded, creditsAvailable and topUpUrl (it will not be retried: top up and create the video again). Requires the "video:read" scope. Read-only, never charges credits. Also polls a motion clip made by generate_motion_clip: the answer then has kind "motion_clip", the promptSent, and on FAILED an errorCode and creditsRefunded.

id.description: The video id returned by create_video or list_videos.

name: get_video
title: Get a video
